author: David Beards
text: If it keeps disconnecting try uninstalling and reinstalling the app. That was a fix given to me by abbotts ages ago. It does mean there will be no old data in the app but that will all have been stored online so you won’t have lost anything.

author: grumpiegramma
text:
Don't remove it just yet,  connect with Abbott customer service place the physical PHONE call  
if you've still have any thing from the package with the lot# etc they'll redirect you to technical support team,  they'll scan the sensor,collect the data, and attempt to determine causation,  many times they'll replace it and request the faulty product be returned.  Bluetooth connection could be the causation, especially those using the app/phone vs the receiver/glucometer from Abbott system.  Advantage the phone app offers  Abbott reps in the tech department  has said more times than not,  phone apps seem to have most episodes of signal problems than the company issued  glucometer receiver 🤷‍♀️ phone app being an Abbott Lab development,  phones themselves can be likely the obstacle
